info.title: Planty API
info.description: A REST API for Planty - tracking plant care and growth metrics

put.summary: Update a user's role and permissions

201.description: Message sent and AI response received

post.summary: Store Google OAuth tokens (called by frontend after callback)
Sync plant care tasks to Google Tasks

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of plants to return

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: date_asc, date_desc, name_asc, name_desc

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: Include archived plants in list results

200.description: List of care tasks for plant

CareTask.description:
A care task represents a specific type of care activity for a plant.
Examples: "Water", "Fertilize", "Prune leaves", "Repot", "Rotate", "Mist", etc.
Each can optionally have a recurring schedule (interval_days).

daysOverdue.description: How many days overdue (negative = days until due, 0 = due today, positive = overdue)

isDue.description: Whether the task is currently due

nextDue.description: When this task is next due (None if no interval or never performed with no interval)

CareTaskWithStatus.description: Computed view of a care task with due-date info for the frontend

notes.example: Time to water your Fiddle Leaf Fig. Remember to check soil moisture first.

CreatePlantCareTaskInput.description: Inline care task definition used when creating a plant

careTasks.description: Initial care tasks to create with the plant

careTaskIds.description: Care tasks to mark as completed

LogCareTaskRequest.description: Request to log a care task completion (creates a tracking entry + updates last_performed)

Measurement.description: A single measurement within a tracking entry

taskIds.description: Ordered list of care task IDs in desired order

access_token.description: The access token from Google OAuth

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp when the token expires

refresh_token.description: The refresh token from Google OAuth (optional)

days_ahead.description: Number of days in the future to sync tasks

replace_existing.description: Whether to replace existing tasks or only add new ones

TrackingEntry.description:
A tracking entry is a timestamped event on a plant that can combine any of:
- Care task completions (which care tasks were performed)
- Measurements (metric + value pairs)
- Notes (free text)
- Photos (attached images)

careTaskIds.description: Care tasks completed in this entry

photoIds.description: Photo IDs attached to this entry
